from_node.description: A metastable preindividual system rich in unresolved potentials.

to_node.description: An individuation process generates an individuated unit together with a correlated milieu.

bridge.statement: Process-first reconstruction may explain boundary emergence and unit formation, but process priority is not a universal axiom.

scale_check.bridge_burden: Cross-domain transfer from physical to vital/psychic/collective individuation requires a new bridge.

ind4.counterpartition: substance/structure-based account of the same unit
ind4.discriminator: which model better explains boundary emergence, persistence and causal powers
ind4.revision_trigger: A region where process-model adds no explanatory gain over a stable-unit model.

audit_semantics.relation_rationale: The available orientation source does not establish an interventionist causal relation; RT00 preserves the ontogenetic reconstruction without counterfeit causal precision.
review_notes: RT06 was removed pending primary-text and causal-bridge evidence; W4A-09 remains orientation-only.

rivals.description: Individuation is an intervention-sensitive causal production process.
rivals.bridge: Requires causal assumptions, mechanisms and counterfactual or intervention evidence.
rivals.discriminator: Provide a model in which changes to the preindividual state yield discriminating outcome changes.

rivals.description: Individuation is a constitutive or ontogenetic reconstruction not reducible to causal production.
rivals.bridge: Requires bearer, product, identity and persistence criteria.
rivals.discriminator: Separate constitution of the unit from causal generation of an event.
